title: Iran war and the Gulf
summary: The US–Iran war has run since late February, with a spring ceasefire that collapsed in July. Iran claims new mine strikes on tankers in Hormuz and its offer to reopen the strait still awaits a US answer; Brent is near $112. The Houthis are hitting Saudi Arabia and Yemen's government, killing 60 at an army camp on 19 October.

background.text: War begins; Iran ends international inspectors' access.
A Houthi strike on Riyadh's King Khalid airport kills at least 12 people.
